language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Changes the language of menus, buttons and messages. Your studies, notes, library and Bible texts stay as they are.

theme.darkHint: Deep forest green, easier in low light.

layout.title: Workspace layout
layout.description: Puts the panes back in their usual order (Scripture, Study, Sources) with their usual widths, and shows or hides them as on first start. Only the arrangement on this computer changes; your studies and library are not affected.

about.backup: All your studies are stored in the data folder on this computer. To back them up, copy that whole folder while Abiding Word is closed.

planned.syncText: Keep your studies in step across your own devices, under your control.
planned.integrationsText: Connect other tools you already use.

assistant.intro: An optional helper for your teaching. It comments and suggests; you stay the author, and nothing in your text changes unless you choose it. It works only when you ask.
assistant.remote: When you ask for help, the text you chose is sent over the internet to this service.
assistant.local: Runs on this computer: your text does not leave it.
assistant.modelHint: A suggested model is filled in. Change it only if you want a different one.
assistant.addressHint: Leave empty to use the service’s usual address. Only needed for a different server, or a program running on another computer.
assistant.keyHint: Kept in this computer’s password store, never in your studies, and not shown again.
assistant.keyKept: A key is kept on this computer.
assistant.keyKeptPlaceholder: A key is kept (type to replace it)
assistant.keySaved: The key is kept on this computer.
assistant.searchHint: An AI assistant cannot be trusted to remember facts: it can tell a story that sounds true but never happened. So to find real stories, Abiding Word asks a search service for real sources and shows them to you. Read the sources yourself before you use a story.
assistant.findImages: Find freely licensed images on Wikimedia Commons (only search words are sent)
assistant.generateImages: Allow making images (always marked as made by the assistant)
assistant.generateOnlyOpenai: Making images works with OpenAI or another compatible service only.
assistant.perspective: How should the assistant place theological questions?
assistant.perspectiveHint: In a few words: your church tradition, or how disputed questions should be handled. Left empty, the assistant assumes no particular tradition and says where Christians read a passage differently.
assistant.testOk: Connected. The assistant answered and is ready.
assistant.offHint: Turn on the assistant to choose a service and check the connection.

localHelp.title: How do I set up {{service}}?
localHelp.what: {{service}} is a free program that runs an AI model on your own computer. It needs no key and no account, and your text never leaves your computer. It works best on a fairly powerful computer, and answers can take longer.
localHelp.steps: Install {{service}}, download a model in it, and leave it running. Then enter the model’s name below and check the connection.

assistant.otherHelp: For a service that works like OpenAI’s. Enter the address from its instructions, a key if it needs one, and the model’s name.

keyHelp.title: How do I get a key?
keyHelp.whatA: A long code from {{service}} that lets Abiding Word use your account there. Treat it like a password and keep it to yourself.
keyHelp.whyA: {{service}} runs the assistant on its own computers. The key tells it that a request comes from your account.
keyHelp.whereA: Sign in on the {{service}} website (or create an account), open the page for API keys and create a new key. Copy it straight away: it is usually shown only once.
keyHelp.costA: Usually yes, a little: {{service}} charges for what you use, often a few cents for a request. Some services give free credit to start. You arrange payment on their website, not in Abiding Word.
keyHelp.pasteA: In the Key field above. Then choose Keep key.

assistant.modelHintEmpty: Type the model’s name as {{service}} shows it.
assistant.checking: Checking the connection… This can take a few seconds.

why.noKey: To check the connection, first paste your key and choose Keep key.
why.noModel: To check the connection, first enter the model’s name.
why.noAddress: To check the connection, first enter the address of the service.
why.badAddress: The address of the service must begin with http:// or https://.

perspectiveExample.views: On disputed questions, show the different views first.
